description.value: Kent's Ice Cream Co. is a homegrown Fraser Valley ice cream brand with three locations, including a Chilliwack shop on Yale Road serving rotating house-made flavours like Sea Salt Caramel and Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough. The shop also sells 11.4L take-home buckets and hires out a mobile ice cream cart for weddings, parties, and corporate events. It makes a natural sweet stop for cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley corridor.
